exact_statement: For every balanced Boolean g, integer r>=1 and complete nonempty core spectral subprobability reference R_g of finite cost c_g, with p=2^(-r) and F=1+A_r(g-1) on fresh independent point controls, the explicit complete output subprobability reference Q_F has vacuum mass (1-p)^2, control-only nonempty mass p^2 per set, and mass p^2 R_g(T) for every control set U and nonempty data set T. It has total mass 1-p+p sum R_g and exact cost CE(P_F,Q_F)=p*c_g+A_r, A_r=2rp(2-p)+(1-p)^2 log2(1/(1-p)^2). The sharp universal selector coefficient is max_{r>=1} A_r/(rp)=C_act=15/4+(49/12)log2(8/7) in (4.536,4.537), uniquely attained at r=3. For the true control-first witness W retaining its physical stopping/core leaf J, actual leaf spectrum and queried membership bits, H(W|S)=2(1-p)+sum_{k=1}^r 2^(-(r-k)) B_k-A_r, B_k=q_k h2(epsilon_k)+(1-m_k^2)/2, m_k=1-2^(-(k-1)), q_k=(1+m_k^2)/2, epsilon_k=2^(-2(k-1))/(2(1+m_k^2)). This posterior is independent of the balanced core and tends to two bits. Disjoint-reference composition and fresh-character balancing preserve the full core bill; no arbitrary-core influence bound or shared-control transfer is assumed.
